--- Retrieved Document 1 ---
Title: Document
The learning rate is a foundational hyperparameter in machine learning that controls the step size while updating the weights of a model during optimization. It dictates how much to change the model in response to the estimated error each time the weights are updated. Choosing the optimal learning rate is crucial; a value too high can cause the model to converge too quickly to a suboptimal solution or overshoot, while a value too low may result in a painfully slow training process.
